content.Jediz è un rapper romano. Scrive e compo: Jediz is a rapper from Rome. He writes and composes his own songs and plays them live with a band. His first album, Dr. Jediz & Mr. I, came out on 1 May 2026.
content.Jediz è il nome con cui Elia Pergola scr: Jediz is the name Elia Pergola writes, produces and performs under. He's from Rome, from San Lorenzo.
content.Pubblica dal 2020, con il singolo Piazza: He has been releasing music since 2020, starting with the single Piazzale Belvedere (Cala Piccola) and the EP Hikikomori (La mia quarantena); Il Folle Volo followed in 2021, then BurnOut in Barna and the single OraMai with Caligola in 2022. In 2025 came the singles Cala Piccola (2025), Rapper / Avvocato and Tempo al tempo.
content.Il 1° maggio 2026 esce Dr. Jediz & Mr. I: On 1 May 2026 he released Dr. Jediz & Mr. I, his first album: eleven self-produced tracks, with Lamia on Il Vaso di Pandora.
In summer 2026 he took the album on tour. On 2 September he opened for Ernia at the marina in Pescara. Tempo al tempo became the soundtrack of Straordinaria, a short film by Antonio Maria Castaldo produced by Yagi Media. On 27 September he closed the summer at the Giardini dell'Acqua Paola, above the Fontanone on the Gianicolo, with his first Rome concert with the band.
content.Dal vivo suona con Tommaso Marino alla c: Live, he plays with Tommaso Marino on guitar, Tommaso Bonifazi Razzanti on bass, Gregorio De Rosa on piano and Luca Lo Presti on drums. Together they rearranged the songs for the stage, and they are working on the new album.
content.Parallelamente alla musica, è praticante: Alongside music, he is a trainee lawyer in Rome.

content.Ernia conquista il Porto Turistico di Pe:
Ernia takes over the Porto Turistico in Pescara: urban, poetry and the energy of Jediz

The Milan rapper won over the Festival Dannunziano crowd. Opening the night: the authenticity and sharp rhymes of Rome's Jediz.

Last night the Porto Turistico in Pescara became the perfect arena for one of the most anticipated nights of the Festival Dannunziano. Ernia was the undisputed headliner, but the stage was alive from 9:30 pm thanks to Jediz. The Roman rapper had the tough job of warming up the crowd, packing seven tracks of raw flow and Roman attitude into half an hour (full article on the website).

content.Jediz è il nome con cui Elia Pergola scr: Jediz is the name under which Elia Pergola writes, produces and takes the stage. He is from Rome, from San Lorenzo, and has been releasing music since 2020. His first album, Dr. Jediz & Mr. I, came out on 1 May 2026. Live, he plays with a five-piece band. Tempo al tempo is the soundtrack of the short film Straordinaria by Antonio Maria Castaldo.

Jediz is the name under which Elia Pergola writes, produces and takes the stage. He is from Rome, from San Lorenzo. He learned rap in the city, from the ground up: freestyle, clubs, encounters. Meanwhile he studied law, graduating with full marks and honours. Rome gave him the language, boxing the discipline, study the method.
content.Pubblica dal 2020, con il singolo Piazza: He has been releasing music since 2020, starting with the single Piazzale Belvedere (Cala Piccola) and the EP Hikikomori — La mia quarantena. Then came the EPs Il folle volo (2021) and Burnout in Barna (2022) and the double single Oramai with Caligola. 2025 brought Cala Piccola (2025), Rapper / Avvocato and Tempo al tempo.
content.Il 1° maggio 2026 esce Dr. Jediz & Mr. I: On 1 May 2026 he released Dr. Jediz & Mr. I, his first album: eleven self-produced tracks, with Lamia on Il Vaso di Pandora. The title nods to Jekyll and Hyde, but there is no good and evil here. There are the lawyer and the rapper, who talk to each other in Harvey Specter.
content.Nel 2026 il disco va sul palco: Barcello: In 2026 the record goes on stage: Barcelona in February, the release party in Rome in April, then the summer. On 2 September he opens for Ernia at the Festival Dannunziano in Pescara; on 27 September he closes the season at the Giardini dell’Acqua Paola, above the Fontanone on the Gianicolo, with his first Rome show with the band.
content.Tempo al tempo è la colonna sonora di St: Tempo al tempo is the soundtrack of Straordinaria, a short film by Antonio Maria Castaldo produced by Yagi Media. Jediz is also working on the soundtrack of Conquer the Jungle, a documentary by Iker Cimadevilla (Mendigo Films), due in 2027.
content.Dal vivo canta con Marianna Vernuccio e: Live, he sings with Marianna Vernuccio and plays with Tommaso Marino on guitar, Tommaso Bonifazi Razzanti on bass, Gregorio De Rosa on piano and Luca Lo Presti on drums. With them he has rearranged the songs for the stage and is working on the new album, Oramai siamo cresciuti.
content.Accanto alla musica resta il diritto: do: Alongside the music there is the law: after his degree, legal training in Rome.
